definition: to have people expecting a lot from you
description: In a grand gilded hall with a painted ceiling and a huge crystal chandelier, a young chef in a white jacket, her hair in a bun, stands behind a table with a white cloth and carefully adds a piece to a tall pink and gold cake built from sugar shards. Three judges lean in close to inspect it: a woman in a burgundy blazer, a young man in a navy suit who straightens up with a serious look, and a woman in a green dress. A trolley stands on the patterned parquet floor.

taps.phrase: to hang from the painted ceiling
